keyFindings.description: The capability report misstates a worker capability: the `codegraph` row is an image row whose check proves the CLI on PATH and @bopstack/pi-codegraph enabled in the profile lock, so the probe table prints `capability codegraph: present` and `legion state --json` renders `codegraph: present (checked by the daemon's probe of the worker image, which passed)` — while every worker pod's agent is launched `--no-extensions --extension <envoy> --extension <legion>` (runtime/sandbox/manifest.go:275; bootgate.go:280 probes the same lane), so the profile plugin never loads and no worker has a codegraph tool until LEGION-629 turns discovery on (the spec's own audit measured this: 'no pod has the tool'). A report whose job is to name what a worker lacks instead of the worker finding out mid-task cannot say present for that row. Fix, implementer's choice of shape: the row's probe line and its `legion state` row must say what was proved (the CLI and the enabled plugin in the image) and that a pod's agent gets the tool only once the pod's launch loads profile plugins (dispatch://LEGION-629), and must not read as a worker capability already present — e.g. a status other than present for the worker-facing row, or a detail that carries the dependency on both surfaces, with the docs/kubernetes.md row and the table's rendering tests following. The lasting fix (discovery on / a third --extension) stays LEGION-629's.

A live row renders as `checked live against a running pod` and the docs say the live rows 'are proved against a running pod', but nothing in this diff runs a live check: `live` is a site label. For repository-extensions the capability is disabled at this head by the same --no-extensions. Word it as the pending check it is ('to be proved by a live check against a running pod (LEGION-629)') and change the docs sentence.

57cf6a62's comments (at the architect's request) describe LEGION-629's lane as present fact — plugins never linked into the profile, discovery on, an OK line carrying extensions=discovered — while this head links both plugins at step 3 (491-492), probes with --no-extensions and prints no extensions mark; the file contradicts itself and docs/kubernetes.md:130. Nothing machine-reads the comments. The architect chose it to keep #1848's hunk conflict-free; recorded in Not proven / risk. A future-tense clause ('after LEGION-629 (#1848): …') would be accurate and equally conflict-free — the architect's call.
Still says `legion.daemonApiVersion` is 'currently 14' after the bump to 15; nothing pins the README. Say 15 or drop the number.

The new comment says maxDetail caps a capability line's detail; it caps only a command's quoted output inside the detail (image.go:66-68, oneLine), so the longest line is ~450-500 bytes and 100 of them ~50 KB — still inside the 64 KiB LimitReader, and a passing pod's log is ~21 lines, so the conclusion holds; reword the arithmetic.

'compile-time' is wrong for the three hold_test.go sites that compared []record.OutboxPayload with slices.Equal: an interface type is comparable, so they compiled and would panic at run time; CI's test run is the check there. Reword.
